problem: Print-ad and marketing-plan runs could silently continue when the current environment had no callable raster image-generation capability, hiding a production-critical quality limitation from the user.

behavior_contract.accepted_capability: A currently callable raster generator whose operations include generate; provider names such as gpt-image, OpenAI image_gen, and Nano Banana are examples rather than an allowlist.
false_proxies: an installed skill or disconnected plugin
behavior_contract.missing_or_unknown: Disclose the severe quality impact and ask the user to enable or switch environment, or explicitly accept limited concept-only mode.
behavior_contract.limited_mode: Text, wireframe, and low-fidelity placeholder concept work only after explicit impact acknowledgement.
behavior_contract.production_and_delivery_requirement: Capability status available, a named callable provider, generate in operations, and use-available-capability decision.
